facts.statement: The genus Pterofiltrus was named by Jiang Shunxing and Wang Xiaolin in 2011.
facts.quote: Pterofiltrus was named by Jiang Shunxing and Wang Xiaolin in 2011.

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Pterofiltrus qiui.
facts.quote: The type species is Pterofiltrus qiui.

facts.statement: The generic name comes from Greek and Latin words meaning 'wing' and 'filter' or 'felt', referring to the animal's teeth.
facts.quote: The generic name is derived from Greek πτερόν, pteron, "wing", and a Mediaeval Latin filtrum, "felt" or "filter", in reference to the dentition.

facts.statement: The specific name 'qiui' honors Professor Qiu Zhanxiang.
facts.quote: The specific name honours Professor Qiu Zhanxiang.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil was found in the early 21st century at Zhangjiagou, Liaoning Province, in rocks dating to about 125 million years ago.
facts.quote: The holotype of Pterofiltrus, IVPP V12339, was discovered in the early 21st century at Zhangjiagou in Liaoning Province in a layer of the Jianshangou Beds of the lower Yixian Formation dating from the early Aptian, about 125 million years old.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a disarticulated skull, parts of a hyoid bone, and the first two neck vertebrae.
facts.quote: It consists of a disarticulated skull compressed on a slab together with two rami of a hyoid and the first two neck vertebrae.

facts.statement: The upper profile of the skull is smooth and slightly concave, lacking any bony crests.
facts.quote: It has a smooth, slightly concave, upper profile lacking any bony crests.

facts.statement: The lower jaws are long and lack a keel.
facts.quote: The lower jaws too are long, and without a keel.

facts.statement: The front teeth differ in length from one another.
facts.quote: The front teeth differ in length.

facts.statement: The underside of the lower jaw symphysis features a trough.
facts.quote: The underside of this symphysis features a trough.

facts.statement: The teeth are very elongated and pointed, directed partly sideways.
facts.quote: The dentition consists of very elongated pointed teeth, directed partly sideways.

facts.statement: The teeth generally increase strongly in length toward the front while becoming more directed anteriorly.
facts.quote: These on average strongly increase in length to the front meanwhile becoming more anteriorly directed.

facts.statement: The lower jaw is 174 millimeters long and contains about twenty-seven teeth.
facts.quote: The 174 millimetres long lower jaw contains about twenty-seven teeth.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis recovered Pterofiltrus as the sister taxon of Gladocephaloideus within the Ctenochasmatidae.
facts.quote: They recovered Pterofiltrus as the sister taxon of Gladocephaloideus, both within the Ctenochasmatidae.

facts.statement: Pterofiltrus lived during the Early Cretaceous in western Liaoning, China.
facts.quote: Pterofiltrus is a genus of ctenochasmatid pterosaur from the Early Cretaceous of western Liaoning, China.

facts.statement: Pterofiltrus lived from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: The holotype fossil dates to the early Aptian, approximately 125 million years old.
facts.quote: The holotype of Pterofiltrus, IVPP V12339, was discovered in the early 21st century at Zhangjiagou in Liaoning Province in a layer of the Jianshangou Beds of the lower Yixian Formation dating from the early Aptian, about 125 million years old.
